overview: A pen at the spawn, for two kinds of people: the ones who have not said the password yet, and the ones an operator has put there.

1.0.5: A command is held at the door whichever of the two ways the game sends it.
Before, one of those ways went straight through, so somebody who had not said the password could still run commands.
1.0.4: Somebody at the door is held from everything, not just from the world.
The greeting and the mod list wait until the password is answered.
1.0.3: No change to play: a fresh number so the build had a file of its own to go up.
1.0.2: Your game is handed a pass when you are let in, so a changing address is not asked twice.
Forgetting a name, or setting a new password, takes the passes with it.
Anyone who logged out in another dimension is greeted properly.
1.0.0: The pen: held within sixteen blocks of world spawn, behind a border wall only you can see.
You can touch nothing and be hurt by nothing, and are put back exactly where you were taken from.
A newcomer is asked for the password in chat, which a stock client can answer.
An operator can jail somebody for a while, or until freed.
